subject: Laptop battery drains quickly
description: Battery runtime is much shorter than usual.
resolution_note: Check power, cables, docking connections, and approved device diagnostics. Escalate hardware faults to desktop support.

subject: Printer job is stuck
description: Print jobs remain in the queue and do not print.
resolution_note: Check printer status and queue, confirm the selected printer, and follow approved queue restart steps.

subject: Outlook is not syncing
description: New messages are not appearing in Outlook.
resolution_note: Check service status, restart Outlook, confirm connectivity, and follow the approved mailbox repair steps if needed.

subject: Application update failed
description: The managed application update did not complete.
resolution_note: Capture the error, restart the application, verify managed updates, and escalate with logs if the issue continues.

subject: Endpoint security alert
description: The endpoint tool displayed a security alert that needs review.
resolution_note: Do not dismiss the alert; preserve evidence and route to the security team for investigation.

subject: Access denied to shared folder
description: The user cannot open a shared folder they normally use.
resolution_note: Verify the requester through the approved process, check account status, and use the approved self-service or service-desk reset workflow.

subject: Cannot reach internal service
description: The internal service cannot be reached from the office network.
resolution_note: Confirm scope, compare affected users/locations, check approved network status, and escalate broad impact.

subject: VPN authentication error
description: The VPN client rejects the user's current sign-in.
resolution_note: Confirm internet access, restart the approved VPN client, refresh its approved profile, and retry. Escalate if the issue persists.
